lead: Wednesday's funding wire ran hot - [Cyera raised $400M](../summaries/4eaf196b01fe.md) from Goldman Sachs, [Micro1 hit a $4B valuation](../summaries/f29ad7754038.md), and [Firecrawl raised $75M](../summaries/aed66f1ed130.md) for agent web scraping - while [Alibaba outlined its first cloud regions](../summaries/5c70f233b9ff.md) in Turkey, Finland and the Netherlands and [Anthropic teamed with OpenEvidence](../summaries/7ae0154c4306.md) on medical AI search for ~100 countries. Hacker News crowned a rebuttal implementing [Jev in 25 lines of Python](../summaries/c1f415621917.md) and a finding that [Claude Code only reads AGENTS.md with telemetry on](../summaries/ee6ebd402552.md). On policy, the [UK's CMA proposed search and AI-assistant choice rules](../summaries/8add4b29dbcf.md); the reading list keeps DeepSeek's [DSec sandbox infrastructure](../summaries/e35d02aab32b.md).
